english.title: Holder of a full Passenger Carrying Vehicle licence being under 21 years of age fail to comply with condition of licence
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being a person under the age of 21 and the holder of a full passenger carrying vehicle drivers licence, failed without reasonable excuse to comply with the prescribed conditions in that **(..SPECIFY FAILURE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 114(1) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

english.notes:
(i) See regulation 15 of the Motor Vehicles (Driving Licences) Regulations 1996 for conditions attached to provisional licences and regulation 51(1) for additional conditions relating to LGV Trainee Driver's Licences.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wording: H3307.
